sources.title: Conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data ...
sources.snippet: Abstract In this paper, conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) are proposed to enhance the data transmission and reconstruction over wireless channels. The underlying mechanism of DDPM is to decompose the data generation process over the so-called "denoising" steps.
